fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (381.44), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and upcoming earnings in 28 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for KMI trading.
